$schema-note: The design-repo's own registry. Every number in `counts` is RECOMPUTED from the files it summarises by extraction/verify_all.py — none of it is hand-maintained.
versionFieldNote: `allowlistVersion` is MACHINE-CHECKED: extraction/verify_all.py fails the run if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own version field. `repositoryVersion` and `pageSpecVersion` are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, hand-maintained markers — nothing checks them automatically. Do not read them as an enforcement guarantee. See tokens/llm/token-policy.json for the full enforced-vs-convention split.

publicationPolicy.reason: The source is a REAL, LIVE company's website (natural.com). The copy is transcribed verbatim and public/assets/ holds real downloaded brand assets. This repo must not be published, open-sourced, or made a public repository. See assets/asset-roles.json globalProhibitions.

themeNote: The source site ships exactly one theme — no prefers-color-scheme rule, no dark: variant, no [data-theme] selector anywhere in src/ (verified by grep).

sourceProject.name: Natural (natural.com clone)
sourceProject.framework: React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS v3 + react-router-dom v7
sourceProject.locationNote: The source tree sits as a sibling of this folder. Its path is deliberately NOT recorded — an absolute local path would break the moment this repo is extracted elsewhere.

entryPoints.$note: Only files INSIDE design-repo/. No `../` paths. An entry point is a promise about THIS package's own contents, so a zipped or standalone copy must not reference files it does not contain. Build-time evidence citations live in extraction/measured-values.json instead, which degrades gracefully (warn, not fail) when no sibling source tree is present.

verification.$note: Run extraction/verify_all.py to reproduce all of this. Never trust these flags without re-running it.
verification.selfContainment: copy design-repo/ to an empty temp dir with no siblings and re-run every script there
